title: Resident Handbook: Temporary Absences from Assisted Living
content:
Residents under the Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement may leave the community for a time — a hospital admission, a skilled nursing or rehabilitation stay, or an extended family visit.

**Recording an absence.** A temporary absence is recorded with its start date and reason, and the apartment stays held while rent continues to be paid. The midnights away are counted as the return date — or the handling date while the resident is still away — less the absence start date, in calendar days.

**Rent.** Rent is never credited for an absence, because the agreement provides no rent credit during an absence.

**The absence care credit.** An absence care credit is posted at most once per absence per billing month. An absence credit may be posted only while the residency is in active, notice given or vacated status, that is after the resident has returned or the residency has ended during the absence.

**Long absences.** When an absence reaches the leave review point (60 midnights) the executive director decides whether the apartment continues to be held; that decision is outside the desk's authority.

**Retired clauses — no longer in force.** The following clauses are no longer in force and have been superseded by the current basis: "On return, the care fee is relieved for long absences: the credited days are the absence's midnights away less the absence credit waiting period, never below zero and never above the maximum credited days." and "Each credited day is credited at the absence credit percentage of the daily care fee of the level billed in that month, the daily care fee being the monthly care fee divided by the days in that month; one absence care credit is posted per absence per billing month, referencing that month's care fee charge and carrying the absence start date, each rounded to the cent half up."

### Questions answered

**May a credit be posted while the resident is still in hospital?** No. While the residency is on leave the status is not one in which an absence credit may be posted; it may be posted after the return (active or notice given status) or after the residency has ended during the absence (vacated status).

**How many midnights is an absence from 2 April to 20 April?** 18 midnights (hypothetical dates).

**Can a second absence care credit be posted for the same absence and the same billing month?** No; at most one per absence per billing month.
